title: FALCON Yemen 2020: Research Software and Source Provenance (Reviewer Reproducibility v1.0.2)

creators.name: Al-Tayar, Ezzaldeen
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Engineering and Information Technology, Taiz University, Taiz, Yemen

description: Curated original Python research software and an executable reviewer protocol for reconstructions from original January 2020 RIPE RIS source RIBs, 2020 IODA publisher raster images, and a separate 2023 IODA API event. It includes source URLs, SHA-256 provenance and author-prepared aggregate reference fixtures. It excludes original RIPE MRT binaries, individual peer-prefix rows, third-party publisher PNG files, raw provider IODA JSON, internal referee correspondence and manuscript drafts. Offline preflight does not constitute a complete fresh 12-RIB reparse and 2023 API re-fetch has not been independently verified. Observational route changes do not establish a causal physical cable path or end-user outage.
notes: MIT is limited to original author-owned Python source software; author-created S14/S15 reference tables and prose are separately CC BY 4.0. Third-party RIS/Atlas/IODA data and imagery are excluded and not sublicensed. Earlier software DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23751733.
